New GPU Helper Functions

These helper functions simplify implementing batch collision checking for GPU-accelerated planning.

BatchCollisionCheckerConfig

Configuration class with presets (fast/accurate) for batch checking

generateBatchCheckerTemplate()

Generates TypeScript code template for collision checker implementation

interpolateEdge()

Interpolates joint configurations between two points

interpolateEdgesBatch()

Batch interpolation for multiple edges - GPU optimized

aggregateBatchResults()

Aggregates per-sample collision results into per-edge results

GpuPlanningContext Presets

fast(), balanced(), quality() presets for Lazy-PRM configuration
